name: Racefemine
summary: Dextrofemine (INNTooltip International Nonproprietary Name), sold under the brand names Marsyl and Dysmalgine, is a uterine spasmolytic and muscle relaxant of the amphetamine family. It is the dextrorotatory enantiomer of racefemine. The drug acts as a β-adrenergic receptor agonist and sympathomimetic. It was marketed in France in 1966 but appears to no longer be marketed.
